justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: RCT evidence shows superiority over dose-matched conventional therapy for bimanual hand function in children with unilateral CP.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Specialized 2-week training program; limited sites; significant time and travel commitment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Highly specialized for children with unilateral cerebral palsy; very limited outside pediatric neuro intensive programs.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed as intensive OT/PT; no certification-specific code; coverage variable; many families self-pay.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer demand; niche pediatric neuro cert primarily at academic medical centers.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Children and families report high engagement and meaningful functional gains; peer interaction adds social benefit.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: CP families routinely pay cash for intensive camps; strong out-of-pocket model.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Intensive camp model supports $3-8K per child packages.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very rare among pediatric clinicians; HABIT-ILE providers are sought out nationally.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Intensive model is staff-heavy but staff must be trained; bottleneck is camp-based not scalable like franchise.
justifications.business.marketDemand: CP parent communities know HABIT/CIMT by name; moderate-to-high niche demand.
justifications.business.efficiency: Training is expensive and time-intensive; not a quick add.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Strong recognition in pediatric academic circles, especially CP research.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active RCT pipeline from Charles/Gordon and Belgian groups.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Excellent exemplar for motor learning and intensive practice principles in peds coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Multiple RCTs supporting HABIT and HABIT-ILE for bilateral CP.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely required in postings but valued for peds faculty lines.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High cost/time relative to academic-line ROI.
